steps_to_reproduce: Open Share on a chat that already has a public link | Click Revoke share | The 'Revoke this share?' dialog is see-through and the 'Public link ready' dialog's buttons and text show faintly behind it, still after 2 s

title: First /chat screenshot after sign-in showed content filling only the top of the viewport (likely screenshot artifact, not reproduced)
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in at /login with a code | On landing at /chat take a screenshot at 1280x820 | The sidebar and content end about two-thirds down with white below; not seen again

title: Free-plan answer shown as a 'Worked for 4s' step with a '?' icon and 'Laying out the answer 40ms'
steps_to_reproduce: Send the dispatch checklist request in a project chat | Open 'Show agent activity: Worked for 4s' | The only step has a '?' icon and says 'Laying out the answer 40ms'; there are no real steps to watch

title: File card shows an unexplained 'Example' badge and wraps the filename mid-word when the side panel is open
steps_to_reproduce: Get the Cedar-Bay-Dispatch-Summary.txt card | Note the 'TEXT/PLAIN' and 'Example' badges; 'Example' is not explained | Open Chat details at 1280 wide; the name breaks as 'Cedar-Bay-Dispatch-Summary.t / xt'

title: Attachment chip close button covers the end of the filename
steps_to_reproduce: Open a project page and attach route-brief.pdf with the + menu | The chip reads 'route-brief.pdf' with the round X sitting over 'pdf' (it shows 'route-brief.pdf' partly hidden)

title: Terms-of-service toast overlaps the top of the answer
steps_to_reproduce: Send the first message in a new chat | A light-blue 'Our Terms of Service were updated...' toast sits over the top of the checklist heading in dark mode, in a different style from the rest of the app

title: Run code approval for a read-only PDF read is labelled 'High risk, can change or delete data, may not be reversible'
exact_text_on_screen: This tool can change or delete data, and its effect may not be reversible.
steps_to_reproduce: Start the Work task with the attached PDF | Look at the first approval card

title: Terms-of-service toast overlaps the plan editor text
exact_text_on_screen: Our Terms of Service were updated. Using AGI means you accept them.
steps_to_reproduce: Send the Work request | When the plan card appears at 1280 wide, the light-blue 'Our Terms of Service were updated' toast sits over steps 1 and 2 and hides their text

title: Attached file chip: file name touches the remove (x) button
exact_text_on_screen: route-brief.pdf PDF - 731 B
steps_to_reproduce: Choose Work, Add photos & files, upload route-brief.pdf | Look at the chip above the message box: 'route-brief.pdf' runs under the x button

title: Stopped run shows all steps with red error icons in the side panel
exact_text_on_screen: Response stopped.
steps_to_reproduce: Start a throwaway Work run | Press Stop at about 15s | Side panel marks 'Writing response' and the step with red error icons, though the message says only 'Response stopped.'

title: Artifact preview shows an 'UNKNOWN' badge and a table cut to 3 of 5 columns
exact_text_on_screen: UNKNOWN
steps_to_reproduce: Press Open on cedar-bay-dispatch-summary.csv | Artifact panel header shows 'UNKNOWN' next to the file name | Table shows only Station, Code, Red units (Blue units and Total count are cut off, no clear scroll cue)

title: At 390 wide the composer placeholder is cut off and the approvals mode is a bare warning icon
exact_text_on_screen: Describe a multi-step task and what it shouldc
steps_to_reproduce: Resize to 390x844 on a Work chat | The composer shows 'Describe a multi-step task and what it shouldc' cut off, and the approvals dropdown shows only a warning icon

title: Credits for the same run differ between views (0.2 vs 0.17)
exact_text_on_screen: 0.2 credits / 0.17 credits
steps_to_reproduce: After the run, open Scheduled | Compare Credits on the card (0.2 credits) with Recent results (0.17 credits)

title: Basic plan card 'What changes' lists only 'Projects with no set limit' and 'Remote Control', not scheduled tasks, even though the Scheduled page says they need Basic
exact_text_on_screen: WHAT CHANGES: Projects with no set limit; Remote Control
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in as the Free account | Open Scheduled and read 'Scheduled tasks are available on Basic and higher plans.' | Click Upgrade plan, then Upgrade plan again, and read the Basic card on /upgrade | The card does not list scheduled tasks

title: Empty Connected tab says 'Nothing matches these filters.' instead of that nothing is connected
exact_text_on_screen: Nothing matches these filters. [Reset filters]
steps_to_reproduce: Open Settings > Connectors | Press the Connected tab with no connectors connected

title: Typing a connector search while offline neither filters nor explains
exact_text_on_screen: Offline (pill); list remains Top connectors
steps_to_reproduce: Open Settings > Connectors | Go offline | Type 'notion' in Search connectors | Observe the unchanged Top connectors list under an 'Offline' pill with no message about the search

title: Add menu in Connectors has only one item, Browse connectors, which just shows the same page
exact_text_on_screen: Browse connectors
steps_to_reproduce: Open Settings > Connectors | Press Add

title: Persistent 'directory is still being indexed' banner on every open
exact_text_on_screen: The connector directory is still being indexed, so a search can miss a server that has not been crawled yet. [Try again]
steps_to_reproduce: Open Settings > Connectors and wait, or press Try again

title: The Settings tab strip at 390 wide clips the last tab at the edge
exact_text_on_screen: Plugins BET
steps_to_reproduce: Resize to 390x844. | Open http://localhost:3000/chat#settings/customize-connectors. | The horizontal tab strip shows 'Plugins BET' cut off at the right edge and 'mize' cut off at the left. It scrolls, so this may be normal for a scroll strip.

title: Menu offers 'Browse connectors' and 'Manage connectors' to a Free user with no paid-plan hint in the menu
exact_text_on_screen: Manage connectors / Browse connectors
steps_to_reproduce: On Free, open + > Connectors. | The menu lists Manage connectors and Browse connectors with no Upgrade badge. | Clicking either lands on the 'Your plan does not include Connectors' screen. This is clear and not an error, but the menu gives no earlier hint.

title: Header badge is cut to 'Isola...' at 390 wide
exact_text_on_screen: Isola...

title: A failed repository URL leaves the picker chip unchanged and a later task start is refused with the same error
exact_text_on_screen: Only public HTTPS GitHub repository URLs in owner/repository form are supported.
steps_to_reproduce: Open Select repository, type 'not a url', press Use this repository (inline error appears) | Press Escape; the chip still reads Select repository | Type a task and start it: error 'Only public HTTPS GitHub repository URLs...' appears above the chips with Retry and Dismiss

title: 'New' button in the Code sidebar does nothing visible for a Free user
exact_text_on_screen: Code is on paid plans (unchanged)
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in as Free and open /code. | Press 'New' at the top of the left list. | Nothing opens and there is no message or Upgrade prompt. Only the existing 'Code is on paid plans' page stays.

title: Offline navigation shows the browser's own error page with no in-app message
exact_text_on_screen: Press space to play / ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED
steps_to_reproduce: Open /code as Free. | Set the browser offline. | Press Upgrade. | The browser dino page appears; setting online and reloading recovers.

title: Opening /code as Free triggers a 503 on /api/github/repositories (console error, not visible on screen)
exact_text_on_screen: No visible text; console only
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in as Free. | Open /code. | Read the browser console: 'Failed to load resource: 503 (Service Unavailable) @ /api/github/repositories'. The server log shows the same request with status error (AppError).

exact_text_on_screen: You've reached the Free limit for now
